prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One original square painted fantasy RPG spell icon, Magic Circle against Good, belonging to an established painterly magical protection family. Three small distinct creature/adventurer silhouettes stand together in an outward ward. The dominant form is a great dark amethyst crescent sheltering the group, its two curved tips anchored on a complete broad glowing oval circle on the ground. The crescent has heavy obsidian-metal substance and a restrained silver-violet rim light. A few distant ivory light rays are turned outward at its rim to communicate warding against benevolent/celestial power. Broad silhouettes, muted rich burgundy shadows, textured oil/gouache paint, dramatic controlled light on a near-black full-bleed background. Three sheltered figures readable at 32px, meaningful subjects inset 15% from square edges. Distinct in form from a sunburst shield: crescent canopy is the single strongest shape. This is protection for every creature inside, never a trap or summon. No text, letters, square border, UI, chains, silver-dust diagrams, pentagrams, prisoners, monsters being summoned, skull portrait, red prohibition slash, or attack beam. Not a recolor of another icon, no grid or contact sheet.
